### Questions you probably have

What is Kinedu, exactly?

It's a baby development app built by child development experts and backed by Harvard research. It gives you a personalized daily plan of activities, tracks your baby's milestones, and connects you with real experts through live classes and courses. Think of it as having a pediatric development specialist in your pocket.

How do I actually get the app?

Sign up here, then check your email — you'll get a temporary password and download links for iPhone and Android. Takes about 2 minutes to be up and running.

What if I have questions or need help?

Just email us at [hello@kinedu.com](mailto:hello@kinedu.com). A real person will get back to you — no digging through a help center to find a contact form.

What age is Kinedu for?

Kinedu covers pregnancy through age 6. Every activity, milestone, and piece of guidance is tailored to your baby's exact age and developmental stage — so the app grows with your child.

Do I need special toys?

Nope. Activities use everyday things you already have at home — spoons, towels, boxes, your own voice. No special equipment or fancy toys required.

Can I use it with multiple babies?

Yes! You can add multiple children to your account. Each one gets their own personalized plan based on their age and development — so if you have a newborn and a toddler, both get exactly what they need.

Attention, moms and expecting moms! Want to feel confident about your child's development? Then, meet Kinedu, the app used by over 9 million families and recommended by pediatricians!

Kinedu is the only app that:

1\. Creates a daily plan with personalized content recommendations, based on your baby's age and developmental stage, or your pregnancy phase.

2\. Provides you with guidance from pregnancy to age 6.

3\. Gives you access to experts, so you feel prepared to give your baby the best start in life.

**\\*\\*\\* HAVE A NEWBORN, A BABY, OR A CHILD? \*\*\***

**With Kinedu, you have a child development guide in the palm of your hand, including:**

**→ Customized activities based on your baby's development: Access daily personalized plans with step-by-step video activity recommendations. Play with confidence, knowing that we've partnered with Stanford University to offer activities that stimulate the right skills at the right time.**

**→ Developmental milestones and progress reports: Keep milestones up to date by completing activities or checking the Progress tab, where you can view progress reports in each area of child development, similar to the ones pediatricians use.**

**→ Expert classes: Join live classes or watch pre-recorded lessons led by baby development experts at your own pace.**

**→ Baby Tracker: Track your baby's sleep, feeding, and growth!**

**\\*\\*\\* PREGNANT? \*\*\***

**We're thrilled to guide you from the very beginning on this incredible journey!**

**→ Track your pregnancy day by day: Access a daily pregnancy plan with tips, articles, videos, and activities!**

**→ Connect with your baby: Track your baby's growth and learn about topics like nutrition, exercise, prenatal stimulation, childbirth, and much more!**

**→ Prepare for your baby's arrival: In addition to all the prenatal content, you'll also get postnatal content! Learn from experts on sleep, breastfeeding, positive parenting, and many other topics.**

**→ Share experiences with other moms and dads: Meet and connect with future parents like yourself during live classes!**

**With Kinedu, you'll have the skills, confidence, and support network you need to give your baby the best start in life.**

**Kinedu \| premium features:**

**\- Unlimited access to 3,000+ video activities.**

**\- Live and recorded expert-led classes on various topics.**

**\- Progress reports in 4 areas of development.**

**\- Unlimited questions to Ana, our AI assistant.**

**\- Account sharing with unlimited members and the ability to add up to 5 babies.**

**Kinedu can also be accessed for free, with limited activities and over 750 articles written by experts, as well as developmental milestones and a baby tracker.**

**Download Kinedu now and build a solid foundation for your child's development. With Kinedu, you'll play, learn, and grow together!**

## The Science Behind Kinedu

![](https://lwfiles.mycourse.app/66452217107262181a0f2f8b-public/7ffeaff2e3df2aae0b750eb53c950738.png)

#### Brain development starts here

Early experiences lay the foundation for your baby’s future. When your child interacts with you during play, their brain architecture is literally being built. Engaged and responsive interactions—what experts call serve-and-return—are crucial for developing resilience and lifelong skills.

(Harvard's Center on the Developing Child)

![](https://lwfiles.mycourse.app/66452217107262181a0f2f8b-public/bf1fdbc03a9cf7a3a771638606a4e8f4.png)

#### Designed by Experts, Backed by Research

Kinedu’s activities aren’t just fun—they’re scientifically designed by early learning experts to boost your baby’s development. A 2016 study by Stanford University showed that these activities significantly enhance how parents engage with their children, both verbally and non-verbally.

(Stanford University Study)

![](https://lwfiles.mycourse.app/66452217107262181a0f2f8b-public/1e5f2a1fa9d4aab0e88b2c141857d9a5.png)

#### The Kinedu Skills® Milestone Model

Our milestone model, developed with insights from MIT and Stanford, goes beyond traditional assessments. It shows how cognitive, social-emotional, physical, and linguistic skills are all interconnected and continuously evolving. This multi-dimensional approach gives you a complete picture of your child’s growth.

(Supported by MIT-Solve and Research from Stanford)
